assembled_coherence.identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of each relative UTF-8 path, NUL, and raw 32-byte file SHA-256; pathlib.Path component ordering, matching scripts/validate.py source_identity; excludes root evidence and target, .git, cache, .local-tooling, .local-build trees, symlinks, ZIP and PYC files
limits: Acceptance applies only to this frozen 744-file source generation and reviewed seams. Generated evidence/pr-followup-validation.json is excluded from source identity and its final executed contents need separate evidence verification.
Component acceptance is preserved rather than repeated wholesale; final analysis component acceptance was coordinated by the root with the separate reviewer.
Source reading and test-oracle inspection do not establish successful execution, native compiler behavior, complete normative conformance, sustained fuzzing or untested platforms.
Temporary old/new diagnostic test generations and finite timings do not establish final-source representative performance, measured visit counts, throughput or whole-process CPU/peak-RSS bounds.

Public sample claims apply only to the exact admitted bytes and rows. A RIB prefix whose parent file was not retained does not establish parent-file identity; these finite samples do not establish representative multi-collector/date/corpus parity or broader supported-profile coverage.
Bundles check producer-declared raw ranges and recomputable provenance; they do not independently map parsed records, replay omitted NDJSON, authenticate source or establish semantic correctness.
Exact-key-set external changes-v1 consumers must explicitly admit the documented additive classification field; their compatibility is not established here.
